notes.title: Patch 1.07
notes.content:
- New artbook pages added
- Korean translation updated

notes.title: Patch 1.06
notes.content:
Additions:
- Added Replay submenu under the Gallery menu. You can now replay your favourite scenes from the DLC.
- Added stages to several CGs

Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where some larger CG images didn't produce correct thumbnails
- Fixed an issue where CG 1 on Page 2 wouldn't unlock

- Fixed an issue where after you get a bad end and return to previous choice, the state of the scene wouldn't be properly restored.

notes.content:

notes.content:

1.02 - fixed an issue where Chasing Tails achievement couldn't be unlocked despite having seen all endings
